"''We have just rescued Master Yoda. It appears this ambush has happened everywhere. We're sending you our coordinates.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Bail Organa|}} The '''''Tantive III''''' {{Pronounced|ˈtæntɪˌvi 'θri:}},[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] also known as the '''''Sundered Heart''''',{{HelmetCollectionCite|2|Databank A-Z}} was the personal [[diplomat]]ic [[cruiser]] of [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. Its [[captain]] was [[Raymus Antilles]]. Unlike other ships of its class, the ''Tantive III'' had a [[hangar]] large enough to fit a [[starfighter]] the size of [[Grievous]]'s [[Soulless One|personal ship]] inside. It was used by the senator to rescue the Jedi [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] and [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], survivors of [[Order 66]]. {{Ship-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The ''Tantive III'' first appeared briefly in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. At the time of the film's release, it was widely assumed that it was the ''[[Tantive IV]]'' from {{Film|IV}}. However, [[Leland Chee]], [[Lucasfilm]]'s Keeper of the [[Holocron continuity database]], later declared it was a different ship, the [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']], although that information was from [[Star Wars Legends]].{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?messageID=17923716#17923653|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2010-08-07|time=2:30 AM}} The canon version was identified as ''Tantive III'' in the [[2016]] edition of the reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]. It was also identified as the ''Sundered Heart'' in the [[Star Wars Helmet Collection 2|second issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Helmet Collection]]''. ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars: The Prequel Trilogy – A Graphic Novel]]'' *{{Film|III}} {{1st}} *[[Ahsoka (novel)|''Ahsoka'']] {{Ab|Ahsoka (audiobook)}} *''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]'' {{Ab|Leia, Princess of Alderaan (audiobook)}} *''[[Leia Organa: Ordeal of the Princess]]'' *[[Crimson Reign 3|''Crimson Reign'' 3]] {{C|Appears on screen}} {{Flash}} ==Sources== *{{SWE|technology|alderaancruiser|Alderaan cruiser}} *{{SWE|characters|captainantilles|Captain Antilles}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|1|Databank A-Z}} {{Po}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|2|Databank A-Z}} {{1stID|''Sundered Heart''}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|12|Databank A-Z}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|35|Highlights of the Saga}} {{Po}} *[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] {{1stID|''Tantive III''}} *''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' *{{HelmetCollectionCite|77|Databank A-Z}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|R2-D2}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|C-3PO}} *[[Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga – The Official Collector's Edition|''Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga'' – The Official Collector's Edition]] {{Imo}} *''[[Under the Helmet: The Legacy of Boba Fett]]'' *{{SW|url=news/star-wars-revenge-of-the-sith-fun-facts-trivia|text=Wookiee Basketball, Kid Han Solo, and a Kenobi Dummy: 20 Fun Facts about ''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith''}} *{{Databank|alderaan-cruiser|Alderaan Cruiser}} *{{Databank|amilyn-holdo|Amilyn Holdo}} {{Po}} *{{Databank|bail-organa|Bail Organa}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Geteiltes Herz#kanon |es=Tantive III |ja=タナヴィーIII |pl=Tantive III |tr=Tantive III }} [[Category:Alderaanian starships]] [[Category:CR70 corvettes]]
